hardware.label: Short screw for the angle bracket

tools.label: Soft surface to work on (rug or blanket)
Drill for the wall holes (not shown in the manual)

steps.text: Push a wooden dowel into one of the two holes on top of each leg.
Set the shelf on the legs and fix each leg with a long screw and the Allen key.

steps.title: Screw the cam bolts into the top
steps.text: Lay the top face down on a soft surface and screw the four cam bolts into it.
tools: Soft surface to work on (rug or blanket)

steps.text: Lower the two side panels onto the cam bolts at each end.
Push a cam lock into each round hole and turn it with a flat screwdriver to lock the sides.
Screw an angle bracket to the top at the back edge, next to each side, with two screws each.
Turn the shelf and legs over onto the sides and fix them with four long screws.

steps.title: Mark the drill holes on the wall
steps.text: Stand the bench upright against the wall and mark through both bracket holes with a pencil.
steps.warning: Always fix the bench to the wall: with a TV on it, it can tip over if a child climbs on it.

steps.title: Drive the wall screws
steps.text: Move the bench away and drive a round-head screw into each mark, leaving the head out.
steps.note: Wall screws and plugs are not included. Use round-head screws that suit your wall, not countersunk ones.
tools: Drill for the wall holes (not shown in the manual)

steps.title: Fix the bench to the wall
steps.text: Push the bench back, hang a keyhole plate on each screw, tighten it and slide on the cover.
